summary: M1 budgeted FX05 isolation run and M2 T1 controlled Web canary cutover: pre-send budget rejection, TaskBudgetStore CAS settlement, EventStore provider.transport.opened+settled as the only durable usage authority, create-only T1 edit gate, and operator-authorized single-flight Web entry for glm/glm-5.3.

components.owning_subsystem: existing TaskBudget CAS store and dispatch gate
components.disposition: Reuse the existing reservation/CAS semantics; add operator-plan mutual-exclusion dispatch, prepared-facts channel into checked_provider_attempt, T1 single-flight and subagent-canary reserve gates. No schema widening, no second ledger.
components.verification_level: M1 focused suite 36 passed; T1/M2 negative matrix in tests/unit/test_task_budget_t1_web_profile.py; parent-side combined regression 750 passed; independent review and full R9 pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The model can stop a run, read the TaskBudgetStore ledger and EventStore events directly, refuse settlement on any join failure (UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN), and use existing service verify/release exits; no bypass of CAS or identity failures.
components.rollback_route: Disable the T1/canary operator plan; ordinary Web sessions never pass through these gates, so removal returns the prior behavior.

components.owning_subsystem: existing Web canary and tool dispatch registry
components.disposition: Operator-authorized single-session T1 budgeted-write Web profile with create-only edit gate armed from real read_file snapshot refs; canary wiring unchanged in authority, scoped to explicit operator authorization only.
components.verification_level: T1 Web negative matrix (no authorization, revoke, replay, CAS conflict, insufficient reservation, missing usage, wrong session/generation, restart-unknown, snapshot drift) in tests/unit/test_task_budget_t1_web_profile.py; no real provider call in tests.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The model can inspect the operator plan, session, and run_generation bindings, decline any edit whose read-snapshot gate is unarmed, and stop the run; every gate is fail-closed and no model output can widen it.
components.rollback_route: Revoke the operator authorization file / disable the canary plan; the T1 profile activates only under explicit operator grant, so removal is immediate.

components.owning_subsystem: M1 isolated FX05 verification harness (explicitly not a production entrypoint)

components.verification_level: tests/unit/test_m1_fx05_budgeted_run.py fail-closed matrix (join missing/duplicate/wrong generation/usage tamper/CAS conflict/unknown kind); one-time real GLM run sealed append-only with receipts; never reused roots.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The model can refuse settlement when the EventStore join fails, keep reservations UNKNOWN, and stop the run; receipts and budget roots remain inspectable on disk for independent audit.
components.rollback_route: Do not run the harness; it mutates only its isolated data root and refuses historical targets, so non-execution is the rollback.
